task.title: Native catalog path silently degrades to anonymous after idle (no session fallback on 200-degrade)
task.description:
Found by P6-010 adversarial review (2026-08-12). The hosted web path now falls back from a stale tr_jwt to tr_session (P6-010, merged), but the NATIVE (Tauri desktop/mobile) catalog half still has the original bug: catalog reads degrade to anonymous with a 200, which NativeBackend send's 401-keyed re-mint (backend/native.rs:132-144) never sees. So after the 15-minute idle window, /catalog and /cards/:id ownership blocks in the desktop/mobile shell silently render as anonymous (no ownership data) until something else refreshes the JWT. Collection reads/writes are fine (401 path re-mints).

Fix sketch: NativeBackend catalog dispatch needs either (a) proactive re-mint when the JWT is expired before sending, or (b) an ownership-aware retry when an authenticated user gets an anonymous-shaped catalog response. (a) is cleaner: check exp before dispatch, re-mint if stale — the mint machinery already exists in native.rs.

Reachability: real on any idle desktop/mobile session browsing the catalog; silent (no error state, just missing ownership badges).
